the part that'd worry me running this for real is "spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar" plus "hard spend caps" in the same sentence. what happens when a job hits the spend cap mid-task, does it downgrade to a cheaper model and keep going quietly, or stop and surface that it ran out of budget. silent downgrade is the dangerous version because the output still looks finished, it's just worse, and nothing in the deliverable tells you the budget ran out before the task did

## Similar Products [...] Coworker agents get their own @ agents email, calendar, Drive and directory presence, and only see what you share with them

Runs in the cloud, so long jobs keep going for hours or days, with one memory across web, mobile, desktop and the command line

Multi-model under the hood: Gemini models plus Claude from Anthropic, with smart routing to keep costs down

Works inline in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Chat and Calendar, and proactively suggests tasks you can hand off

Every agent gets its own identity, audit trail and sandbox, plus real-time spend caps per project

Industry versions in preview for Financial Services and Legal

Really excited to try it out, you can learn more details here.

Gal Dayan
